summary: TPG Twin Brook Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K disclosing routine monthly distributions per share class, NAV as of June 30, 2026, and status of its continuous public offering. The filing reports dividends of $0.20 per share (net of servicing fees for Class S and D), NAV of $25.1993 across all classes, and $2.8 billion raised in its ongoing offering. This is standard operational disclosure for a BDC, not a special situation.
